topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The box on my desk was small, wrapped in plain paper, the kind you find in the back of a drawer, forgotten. The card was tucked under the bow, the handwriting at once familiar and distant. I scanned the classroom, half expecting to see them standing there, grinning, but the room was empty, just the usual clutter of desks and chairs. My fingers lingered over the wrapping, my mind flickering through memories of that particular student, their laughter, their struggles, the tiny victories we celebrated. I hesitated, wondering what the years had brought them, what message they might have sent. Finally, I took a shallow breath and tore the corner of the paper.
